name: update_paper_narrative
title: Paper Narrative
description: Draft or revise a paper’s paragraph prompts in the author’s established Markdown format or the bundled outline format.

request.description: Requested narrative or revision, including audience, coverage, and any brief for a paper still being drafted.

paper_dir.description: Paper workspace for resolving relative paths. Defaults to the current working directory.

manuscript_path.description: Manuscript source when supplied, especially when a directory contains several versions.

format_reference.description: Path to an accepted narrative to use as the Markdown format model. Only its presentation conventions carry over to the current paper.

narrative_path.description: Requested destination. By default reuse the existing narrative or create NARRATIVE.md beside the manuscript.

dry_run.description: Return proposed narrative text or edits without writing files.

open_points.description: Missing evidence or unresolved decisions affecting the requested narrative.

preview.description: Proposed narrative text or edits for a dry run or review-only request.
